elaine_support: Heads-up — starting ~08:12 UTC eu1 hosted-api is returning 502/504 intermittently, spike to ~18% error rate on /v1/generate, customers reporting timeouts.
joel_support: Affected tenants: acme-inc, sandbox-qa, two trial accounts. Ticket #7882 and #7883 opened.
mike_sre: Investigating — initial signal shows upstream auth latency increase and a wave of RST_STREAMs from auth-proxy. Correlating with our keepalive metrics.
lucy_engineering: We pushed auth-proxy v2 last night with tcp_keepalive_interval=30s and connection_reuse tweaks.
mike_sre: Auth pods are closing idle connections after 25s due to new kube-probe settings; frontdoor still reusing keepalive sockets -> half-closed problem.
elaine_support: Repro steps I ran:
```
wrk -t8 -c200 -d60s --latency 'https://eu1.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -s scripts/persistent.lua
```
with Connection: keep-alive I see repeated 502s after ~20s.
lucy_engineering: Good repro. Looks like mismatch: auth closes at 25s, frontdoor assumes alive and reuses; when backend sends FIN, Envoy returns 502 instead of retrying on new conn.
mike_sre: Short-term mitigation: increase upstream idle_timeout on frontdoor to 60s and enable envoy upstream tcp_keepalive with keepalive_time=10s.
joel_support: I'll notify affected customers and pause new onboarding for a few minutes.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: service=frontdoor region=eu1 user=mike_sre id=deploy-1810005432-01
mike_sre: Rolling patch started.
deploy-bot: deploy success: service=frontdoor region=eu1 id=deploy-1810005432-01 :white_check_mark:
elaine_support: Observing metrics — 502 rate back to normal within ~90s of deploy, latency normalized.
lucy_engineering: We'll follow up with auth-proxy rollback fix to align idle/keepalive and add a test for connection drain behavior.
mike_sre: Leaving this thread open for 1h observation, then will close. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
joel_support: Closing customer tickets after confirmation. Note: add runbook entry for keepalive drift.
